import difflib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/lowcost-europa')
paths=['deploy/systemd/lowcost-europa.service','deploy/systemd/lowcost-europa-weekly-discovery.service','deploy/systemd/lowcost-europa-catalog-maintenance.service','deploy/systemd/lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.service']
report={'mode':'READ_ONLY_DIFF_SERVICE_TEMPLATES','differences':{},'head':None}
r=subprocess.run(['git','-c','safe.directory='+str(root),'-C',str(root),'rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10);report['head']=r.stdout.strip() if r.returncode==0 else None
for rel in paths:
 local=(root/rel).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
 r=subprocess.run(['git','-c','safe.directory='+str(root),'-C',str(root),'show','origin/main:'+rel],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
 assert r.returncode==0
 remote=r.stdout.splitlines(keepends=True)
 diff=list(difflib.unified_diff(local,remote,fromfile='local/'+rel,tofile='github-main/'+rel))
 report['differences'][rel]=diff[:110]
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
